items.difficulty_reason: Exact-functor lemma (statement 4710-4716, proof 4716-4727): a functor between ABC-category differential graded categories compatible with shifts induces an exact functor of homotopy categories - the proof carries the admissible short exact sequences through F and checks the boundary morphism agreement explicitly (F(delta) = F(pi) d(F(s))); the preservation of admissible sequences is the standard additivity argument for R-linear functors, compressed in the source to a single assertion with the mechanism transparent. H2: short functoriality argument.
